You are a programming expert. 
        You will be provided with a patch used to fix a bug. 
        Based on the commit message and modifications in the patch, you need to analyze the root cause of the bug in detail. 

        Here is the patch content:
        From 30aa2e48962c6e4cd5258840f55f2f413b0bdbb4 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Milo Kim <woogyom.kim@gmail.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Dec 2016 15:28:30 +0900
Subject: [PATCH] ARM: dts: am335x: Fix the interrupt name of TPS65217

Use 'interrupt-names' for getting the charger interrupt number.

Fixes: 1934e89a769b ("ARM: dts: am335x: Add the charger interrupt")
Signed-off-by: Milo Kim <woogyom.kim@gmail.com>
Signed-off-by: Tony Lindgren <tony@atomide.com>
---
 arch/arm/boot/dts/am335x-bone-common.dtsi | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/arch/arm/boot/dts/am335x-bone-common.dtsi b/arch/arm/boot/dts/am335x-bone-common.dtsi
index dc561d505bbe..14b62690c464 100644
--- a/arch/arm/boot/dts/am335x-bone-common.dtsi
+++ b/arch/arm/boot/dts/am335x-bone-common.dtsi
@@ -320,7 +320,7 @@ &tps {
 
 	charger {
 		interrupts = <TPS65217_IRQ_AC>, <TPS65217_IRQ_USB>;
-		interrupts-names = "AC", "USB";
+		interrupt-names = "AC", "USB";
 		status = "okay";
 	};
 
-- 
2.25.1


        
        Provide a response strictly in the following format:
        Root cause:<Root cause>

Root cause: The bug was caused by the incorrect usage of the property name for specifying the interrupt names in the device tree source (DTS) file. The original code used 'interrupts-names' instead of the correct 'interrupt-names', leading to a failure in properly retrieving the charger interrupt number for the TPS65217 device. This misconfiguration would prevent the system from correctly handling interrupts related to the charger, potentially causing issues in power management or device operation.

You are a programming expert.
    You will be given the root cause of a bug and  the corresponding patch.

    Provide a response strictly in the following format:
    Code statements:
    <text1>
    <text2>
    <text3>
    <text4>
    ...
    <textN>

Root cause:
The bug was caused by the incorrect usage of the property name for specifying the interrupt names in the device tree source (DTS) file. The original code used 'interrupts-names' instead of the correct 'interrupt-names', leading to a failure in properly retrieving the charger interrupt number for the TPS65217 device. This misconfiguration would prevent the system from correctly handling interrupts related to the charger, potentially causing issues in power management or device operation.
